attributes.action: Referendum: leave the ECHR under Article 58
attributes.additional_details:
This petition asks for a simple Yes/No referendum:
Leave the ECHR using Article 58.
Replace it with a British Bill of Rights.
If Yes wins, the Government must send the leaving notice within 3 months and put the Bill of Rights before Parliament the same year.
This does not change rescue at sea. It decides who has the last word on removals: voters and Parliament, or Strasbourg.
attributes.background: Hold a referendum: leave the ECHR under Article 58 and replace it with a British Bill of Rights. If Yes, send the leaving notice within 3 months and introduce that Bill the same year.

rejection.details: You may wish to sign this petition which calls for a similar action: https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/779881
